messages:
alex: Ran a bulk telemetry reprocess for NA totals overnight. Hit an interesting cascade: router applied aggressive retries and we overwhelmed the dedupe queue leading to a long tail of 'in-progress' jobs in Console. anyone else notice the long tail behavior? :wave:
mei: yup, saw it. The problem looks like lack of hysteresis in retry logic: after a lane starts returning throttles, router immediately retries and oscillates. we should add a per-request backoff window so a lane that fails is avoided for that request for N seconds.
chong: router logs show many quick retries with same request_id. snippet:
```
2026-03-24T22:11:02Z INFO router request_id=rproc-320 lane=recompute:dedupe attempts=1
2026-03-24T22:11:02Z WARN dedupe-queue tenant=delta_inc action=throttle code=429
2026-03-24T22:11:03Z INFO router retrying request_id=rproc-320 lane=recompute:dedupe attempts=2
```
rafa: UX problem: Console shows "running" until orchestrator gives up, which means customers see spinning jobs with no explanation. Support gets pinged. we need an explicit state mapping for lane-throttle->'waiting for lane capacity' and show ETA.
alex: proposal: implement request-level lane-hysteresis: when a lane returns throttle, the router marks that lane as "soft-blocked" for that request for backoff_seconds = min(60, 2^attempts). Router then picks next compatible lane. This prevents hot-looping.
mei: routerside good. Also add global adaptive backpressure: if dedupe throttle rate > 10% in last 1m, lower concurrency for non-critical reprocesses and surface a banner in Console: "Platform under dedupe pressure. Large reprocesses may be slower."
chong: small dev note: add header x-lane-feedback with values {ok,throttle,overloaded} in worker responses so router doesn't parse logs; cheap change.
infra-bot: deploy: recompute-router v3.3 scheduled. includes request-level hysteresis and x-lane-feedback header. Canary window available.
billing-bot: FYI when we route to dedupe-dropped lanes they may incur additional billable ops. We should show estimated incremental cost in the Console reroute modal.
rafa: Console changes: (1) new job state 'waiting: lane capacity', (2) hover shows last 5 lane responses and a suggested action, (3) add "Ops preview" button to leak low-level debug (request_id, last worker hints) for internal users only.
alex: also want a 'timeline' view for reprocess jobs showing per-shard events (queued -> routed -> throttle -> reroute -> success). Useful for postmortems. can we store compact event traces per request?
mei: yes. Emit a lightweight trace event per significant state change. store in telemetry with a TTL of 7 days. Console can fetch compressed timeline and render a sparkline + event list.
chong: telemetry schema: event types [queued, dispatched, lane_feedback, reroute, success, failure]. include request_id, shard_id, lane, timestamp, reason. keep as flat fields.
rafa: UX decisions: Ops preview behind role gate. For customers show only high-level timeline and a link to request audit log. For internal users include raw worker hints.
alex: runbook items: how to demote a running reprocess (flip request flag prefer_non_dedupe=true), how to pause retries, and how to requeue shards to low-cost paths. I'll update the runbook.
mei: safety: add per-tenant backfill rate limit so one tenant can't monopolize dedupe lane. e.g., default max_concurrent_dedupe_reprocess=5. we can make it tenant-configurable.
billing-bot: also capture cost_estimate and mode in telemetry at request creation so we can reconcile billed vs estimated. emit event reprocess_cost_estimate with fields request_id, tenant_id, estimated_tokens, estimated_cost.
rafa: canary plan: pick 12 tenants across tiers, enable hysteresis + timeline for their requests for 24h and measure tail latency, reroute count, and support tickets. infra-bot, schedule.
infra-bot: canary scheduled at 5532609000 for tenant-set "hysteresis-timeline-canary-12". Notifying #eng-sre and #support. :white_check_mark:
chong: quick ask: add recompute_request_id to every dedupe-queue call log to ease correlation. small logging change.
alex: agreed. Also ensure we increment a metric reprocess.reroute_count and reprocess.lane_throttle_rate per-tenant. Console dashboards will surface those.
mei: final UX ask: when a job is 'waiting: lane capacity' show a one-click "request expedited run" which prompts customer to accept a cost delta and then requeues to higher-priority lane. requires billing confirmation. Raf, can you add copy?
rafa: will do. copy will show "Expedite this job (estimated +$X)" with link to billing terms. behind feature flag.
alex: action items: mei add router hysteresis + header; chong add request_id propagation; infra-bot run canary; rafa mock Console timeline and expedite modal; billing-bot wire cost event.
mei: will open PRs. let's keep feature behind flag and collect metrics for 48h before global rollout.
alex: thanks team
